domain: chat pane layout, nested plan steps, mid-run plan revision
summary: Delivered all three WAVE-061 follow-up options. The layout fix was a regression traced back to the dynamic-steps change of the previous wave.

findings.finding: The chat pane stacked message area, planner, and composer in a plain VStack. The planner used to be a fixed three rows, so its height was effectively constant; once steps became dynamic it grew to a dozen rows and took the space out of its neighbours, hiding the composer and pushing the scroll view up. This is the footer/scroll glitch the user reported.
findings.fix: rings/SR-00/ChatPaneLayout.swift bounds the planner to a fraction of the pane, scrolls it internally, hides it entirely when the pane is too short, and gives the composer layoutPriority so it is never negotiable.

findings.finding: Long plans had no structural answer beyond folding, while competitor UIs answer length with nesting.
findings.fix: rings/SR-00/PlanNesting.swift builds parent/child nodes, rolls child state up to the parent, and counts progress across the whole tree. A failed child surfaces through a parent marked complete; an orphaned child stays visible rather than being dropped.

findings.finding: Plans were append-only, but AgentScope treats revise_current_plan as first-class, so a running plan must tolerate reshaping.
findings.fix: rings/SR-00/PlanRevision.swift supports replacePending, insertAfterCurrent, dropPending and rename, under one invariant: history is immutable. Completed, failed and cancelled steps cannot be rewritten or removed, and the running step cannot be dropped.

lessons.lesson: Making a component's height dynamic changes the layout contract of everything stacked with it. The planner growing from 3 to 12 rows silently took space from the composer.
lessons.how_to_apply: When a view's content becomes unbounded, give it an explicit height budget in the same change, and give the non-negotiable sibling layoutPriority.

lessons.lesson: Roll-up must be pessimistic. A parent that reports complete while a child failed hides exactly what the user needs.
lessons.how_to_apply: PlanNesting.rolledUpState surfaces failure first, then running, then pending; complete requires every child complete.

lessons.lesson: Mid-run revision is only safe with an explicit immutability boundary.
lessons.how_to_apply: PlanReviser.isHistory defines it, and wouldRewriteHistory lets a caller report a refusal instead of silently doing nothing.

verification.build_sh: 0 app-source errors, trios_app built, chat e2e 0 failures
verification.runtime: app running, server health ok, cdpConnected true

known_gaps: PlanNesting and PlanReviser are complete and tested but not yet wired into TODOPlanner or the view - the agent does not yet emit parent/child relationships or revision requests.
A2A registration was empty at the end of this wave; it recovers on the next bootstrap.
The postgres stale-lease auth failure in the agent server is still unaddressed and needs DATABASE_URL.
